strategy.extendedWindow: 30 days only with a live direct destination
strategy.coverageGoal: maximum practical coverage; never claim inaccessible or blocked listings were searched

nextRun.notes: Resume the blocked startup-board lane with fresh Wellfound and Instahyre attempts and traverse additional current Cutshort and YC detail pages. Then recheck the 24–26 August employer deadlines, page further through the 63 LinkedIn requests that rate-limited this evening, and sweep every lane again.

sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry the 63 rate-limited or blocked requests, then continue page-150-plus results and narrower pricing, fraud, planning, insights, reporting, reconciliation, and junior data-engineering variants
sourceLanes.notes: The evening past-24-hour sweep expanded to 24 keyword families across four target locations and starts 0, 25, 50, 75, 100, and 125: 576 query-location-page combinations. Sixty-three requests were blocked or rate-limited and remain explicitly incomplete. Eight live roles were verified and added: Moissani, Ethos, Green Positive, Neolytix, Enfinity Global, NTT DATA, Kroll, and RSM. Neolytix and Kroll were canonicalized to employer career pages. Misleading entry-level labels that actually required 4–9 or more years were rejected.

sourceLanes.label: Normal LinkedIn hiring posts
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: fresh original employee, recruiter, and founder posts using reporting, RevOps, risk, data engineering, fresher, graduate, referral, SQL, and Power BI variants after indexing refreshes
sourceLanes.notes: Normal LinkedIn posts were searched independently across four evening query families. Results were older reposts, candidate open-to-work posts, unrelated locations, or posts that withheld the official application route behind comments or groups. No normal post passed the current-original-post plus usable-route gate, so none was promoted. A fresh Neolytix job result surfaced in this lane but was treated as a LinkedIn Jobs discovery and canonicalized to the employer page.

sourceLanes.label: Company careers and ATS pages
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and company-hosted pages, then inspect current Paytm analytical listings whose true seniority is not exposed on the board
sourceLanes.notes: The evening ATS and company-career sweep searched Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, and employer-hosted pages. Neolytix's live canonical RCM MIS and Reporting Analyst form and Kroll's live canonical Restructuring Analyst page were added. Paytm's current board was traversed, but its new visible internships were not sufficiently data-heavy and the analytical roles lacked verified early-career thresholds.

sourceLanes.label: Startup boards
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: More Cutshort API detail pagination, current YC company boards, then retry Wellfound and Instahyre with an accessible authenticated session
sourceLanes.notes: The oldest incomplete lane was resumed first. Instahyre remained inaccessible. Wellfound did not yield a new current direct role, and fresh Cutshort results were duplicates or senior mismatches. YC Work at a Startup exposed Codingal's Operations Associate Intern and Emergent's Data Analyst with live Apply controls, but the pages were crawled roughly 1.2 years and 9 months ago with no recent post or refresh evidence, so they were not published as current. The lane remains partial.

sourceLanes.label: Specialist and early-career portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Additional Internshala pages for BI, MIS, research, risk, and operations analytics once direct detail access returns; then Unstop and Hirist detail pages
sourceLanes.notes: The evening specialist sweep retried Internshala, Unstop, Hirist, and Cutshort query variants. Internshala detail access was blocked by robots in this pass, Unstop and Hirist returned no inspectable fresh detail pages, and Cutshort's current pages surfaced no new distinct early-career analytics role beyond existing board entries. The lane remains partial rather than being labelled complete.

sourceLanes.label: Broad job portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Page further through current Indeed city and synonym searches when the automation gate clears, then retry Foundit and Naukri client-rendered detail extraction and canonicalize destinations
sourceLanes.notes: Naukri and Indeed direct discovery were blocked in the evening web pass. Foundit results were stale, internally inconsistent, or generic search pages rather than trustworthy current destinations; for example, GreenCell Mobility displayed a current-looking label alongside a January-to-March 2025 start window. None passed the freshness and direct-destination gate. The lane remains partial.
